title: Years with Basie, 1938 to 1950 and after
summary: Edison was with Basie from 1938 to 1950 and returned later, treating the band as his chair.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Yeah. How long did you stay with him?

From '38 to '50. Then I went back, you know. And I still go back. So I've been with Basie over a period of 25 years or 30 years. Although I leave and -- but, you know, I still consider that as my chair, you know. And I'm quite sure that anybody who has ever been in his band that is still active, they can always go back. He'll make a way for you, make room for you.

But he has contributed so much to my career, you know. And in New York in those days he used to introduce me to so many people, you know, that I never thought -- I never thought he'd introduce me to Benny Carter, you know. He introduced me to Chick Webb.
Well, that was quite a quick introduction
